limitations: Retained CSV maturity is not proof of original availability or provider completeness.
OHLC does not establish barrier ordering, tradeability or broker fills.
RMS return scale includes drift; it is not a fitted conditional-volatility model.
The comparison module and its additional XML cases were not reviewed or executed by this reviewer.
reviewed_boundaries: Origin high/low excluded from future excursions; initial executable-side spread remains an explicit immediate cost.
Exact nominal endpoint and full consecutive future minute support are separate requirements.
Endpoint return/cost availability does not require complete intermediate paths; missing BA is not inferred.
Long/short executable-side orientation uses shared original-mid bps denominator.
Past60 RMS scale uses only origin and earlier closes; zero/nonfinite/missing support is withheld.
Future realized OHLC ranges and adverse/favorable envelopes are labels, not pre-entry predictors or observed fill paths.
Large price-drop logarithm uses stable log difference to avoid log1p rounding to minus one.
